title: Landmarks are not uniquely named
user_impact: Screen reader users cannot distinguish similar regions.
technical_impact: Repeated landmark roles without unique aria-label/aria-labelledby values.
source: WAI-ARIA 1.2 landmark roles (several landmarks of one role should have unique labels); ARIA Authoring Practices, Landmark Regions; review for SC 1.3.1
applicability: Rendered landmarks: banner and contentinfo (document-scoped header/footer or role), main, navigation, complementary (top-level aside, or a named aside in a section), and named form/region/section.
expectation:
Asks for review at every landmark that shares its role and accessible name
(both unnamed counts as the same name) with another rendered landmark: such
landmarks cannot be told apart. The name may come from aria-label,
aria-labelledby or title. An unnamed aside inside article/section is generic,
not complementary; a header inside main/article is generic, not banner. Copies
hidden per breakpoint are not exposed. A SHOULD in ARIA, hence review. One
review per offending element.
